name: Camping Schlossberg Itter
beschreibung: The Camping Schlossberg Itter is located in the village of Itter in Brixental. It lies at the foot of the Schlossberg, which gave it its name. The site is equipped with pitches for motorhomes and caravans. In addition, permanently installed mobile homes are available for rent. The facility has a swimming pool and a children's playground. From Itter, the ski areas of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental and those of Hopfgarten are easily accessible.
